node.title: Budget-three four-word witnesses have affine rank three
node.statement: For d>=3, four distinct codewords of RS[F,D,2d], |D|=4d, all agreeing with one received word on at least 3d-1 coordinates are affinely independent. A rank-two equality case would force 2d-2 common direction zeros and exactly two listed words at each of 2d+2 active coordinates; factoring the common locator leaves four distinct affine-linear quotients, whose six pairwise differences cannot cover more than six active coordinates. This constrains all thirteen budget-three chambers but closes none without a locator-rank/codeword-rank bridge.
